title: The Cardinal Void

features.name: the fourth direction
features.desc-on-touch: a signal arriving from the point where the compass broke; the archive learned to broadcast from a heading that has no name

features.name: the overlapping north
features.desc-on-touch: three separate norths arriving simultaneously; the paddock's magnetic center shifted and split; your compass needle spins between three truths

features.name: the pool where reflection arrives from no direction
features.desc-on-touch: still water that reflects the sky from all compass points at once; your image appears in each direction simultaneously; the archive has begun comparing itself to itself

features.name: the vectors that unmake each other
features.desc-on-touch: arrows pointing to every cardinal point at once; their intent cancels but their presence accumulates; you stand at the center of their unanimous disagreement

features.name: the broadcast that arrived from everywhere
features.desc-on-touch: a casing voice speaking on a frequency with no origin point; it reaches you from north, south, east, and west with equal strength; it says only: I am here I am here I am here

features.name: the map that learned to read itself
features.desc-on-touch: a faded road atlas where the routes have begun comparing themselves; some roads lead backward now; some intersections exist at multiple coordinates; the corruption has learned triangulation

inscription: the compass points arrive together and their disagreement becomes the only direction that remains

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the paddock stopped teaching north
narr: Leif held the compass and Katita held the map.
The paddock had no landmarks anymore; the roads
had all arrived at once and canceled each other.
You stood together in a place that refused position.
Later she would say: the country has learned to speak back.
